newsitem.title: CHINA: Credit Lyonnais moves Shanghai branch to Pudong.
newsitem.headline: Credit Lyonnais moves Shanghai branch to Pudong.

text.p: The Shanghai branch of France's state-controlled bank Credit Lyonnais officially opened in the city's Pudong New Area on Wednesday, joining the exodus of foreign banks to the development zone, a bank official said.
Pudong, across the Huangpu River from downtown Shanghai, is the only area in China where foreign banks are allowed to conduct transactions in the local yuan currency.
China has so far granted yuan licenses to only nine foreign banks, but foreign bankers have said they are eager to get a share of local currency business.
At least 14 banks had already moved there, the official Xinhua news agency has said.
Around 20 more banks were planning to move to Pudong soon, Xinhua said, quoting official sources.
